purpose: The one place an app sets the GilbPlatform origin and the hosts allowed to receive its credential, so every address and credential rule reads them the same way.
namedChanges: this unit replaces six host literals with settings
There is none. The app this came from falls back to a local address when its environment names no origin; this unit throws instead

0.2.0 adds the settings `setOntologyApiOriginRaw` and `setVocabTypeBatchRevisions`, which replace the environment values `VITE_ONTOLOGY_API_ORIGIN` and `VITE_VOCAB_TYPE_BATCH_REVISIONS` read by `heldTypes.ts`
